assets.prompt: An English front-door letterbox, an envelope being delivered by a hand, a neat notice checklist and proof-of-service notebook. Compose a flowing scene with home architecture extending to the left and an organised plum service folder extending to the right.

A dignified English county court exterior, a carefully indexed court bundle with coloured tabs, spectacles and a fountain pen. Property papers and brass keys at the left lead towards the court on the right. No gavels, no police, no judge characters.

An open rent ledger, bank-statement sheets, a few British pound coins, an envelope and a tidy plum claim file, with a rented English home in the background. Visually show careful accounting and evidence preparation.

A row of comparable English rental homes, a magnifying glass resting over property comparison cards, a calendar, a rental notice folder and a fountain pen. Convey measured property comparison and fair review. No profit arrows, no money pile.
A welcoming ordinary English terraced home, a set of brass house keys being handed over, a signed agreement folder and a modest plant. Emphasise a straightforward whole-property tenancy.

An elegant English residential house, a substantial plum tenancy management portfolio with neatly divided schedules, a fountain pen, inventory checklist and brass keys. Emphasise thorough ongoing landlord management.

A British student rental house, two students' backpacks and university books, a shared tenancy folder and keyring on a desk. Student living and rental paperwork, tasteful, mature rather than cartoonish.

An English shared house with several entrance windows, four distinct keyrings, a neatly organised house-rules folder, fire-safety checklist and communal kitchen detail. Emphasise a managed shared home.
A warm owner-occupied British home with a comfortable spare bedroom visible through a doorway, two tea mugs, one room key, and a simple lodger agreement on a small table. Welcoming shared living.

Welsh slate-roofed stone houses in a green valley, an occupation-contract portfolio with blank pages, house keys and a subtle daffodil detail. Emphasise a private rental home in Wales, no flags, no invented legal symbols.

An Edinburgh-style sandstone tenement and a Scottish residential street, a private residential tenancy folder, house keys and subtle thistle detail. A Scottish letting scene rather than London architecture.

A Belfast-style redbrick residential terrace against soft green hills, a private tenancy agreement folder, house keys and a small flax-flower detail. Northern Ireland rental setting, no political or national symbols.
